name: dev-flow-orchestrator
description: A clear, resumable configurable workflow state machine for Codex on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Runs one V5 controller on macOS. Workflow definitions are declarative YAML files: states, transitions and node contracts are data, not code. Each task pins the exact workflow document that created it, and the agent reads one next-action projection at a time. State stays outside target repositories.
defaultPrompt: Start this requirement with the configured development workflow.
Resume the active development workflow from its saved state.
Continue the current task exactly as its next projection directs.
